facts.business: Suprajit Engineering Limited is a global market leader in automotive cables with manufacturing footprint across India, United States, Mexico, Europe, China, and Morocco, and also operates in halogen lamps, electronics, and braking systems.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Phoenix Lamps Division expected to do better this year due to insolvency of a leading halogen manufacturer and 'The Last Man Standing' strategy
Suprajit Electronics Division expected to continue growth momentum with new contracts for electronic throttle controls, actuators, digital clusters, rotary sensors
New STC infrastructure expected to be operational during the 3rd quarter of the current fiscal year
Technology tie-up with Blubrake expected to develop innovative and low-cost ABS for Indian market
Suprajit Chuhatsu Control Systems JV assessing market entry strategies with two leading Japanese OEMs in India, with product developments underway
Q4 performance of restructured international division showed marked turnaround, trend expected to continue in current year

key_risks: Geopolitical disruption in the Middle East
Significant drop in Middle East business for Trifa brand due to conflict
Insolvency of a leading halogen manufacturer
One-time costs during restructuring of international operations
Impairment risk of investments in subsidiaries (carrying value Rs. 5,453.67 million)
facts.related_party_note: Loans to subsidiaries: Suprajit USA Inc. received additional loans of USD 6 Million (Rs 532.71 Million) and USD 12 Million (Rs 1,084.02 Million) for working capital/capex; converted loan of USD 20 Million (Rs 1,802.79 Million) into equity. Interest receivable on loan to subsidiary was Rs 75.21 Million (March 31, 2025). Dividend receivable from subsidiary was Rs 19.93 Million. Income on financial guarantee receivable was Rs 5.00 Million.
